high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation, likely from MIT given the logo in the bottom right corner. The background of the slide is dark, possibly black or very dark gray, which makes the white and light green text stand out clearly. The title of the slide is "Why Should we Study the Human Brain in the first place?" written in a large, light green font at the top center. Below the title, there are three bullet points, each explaining a reason for studying the human brain: To know thyself. Subtext: "your mind/brain is who you are; understand yourself!"
